Messages.Author: Madman2001
Messages.Body:
Dear Older Vampires:

I realize that minions cannot take the same action twice in one turn.
However, can one minion use two of the same cards during an action??
For example, Sammy tries to bleed. Sammy is blocked by Dre. Sammy
uses Cloak the Gathering. Dre uses KRCG. At this point, can Sammy
throw out another Cloak the Gathering so that he's running at 2
stealth?? Or can he only use, e.g., Faceless Night??

OK, let's say that Dre cannot get his intercept up enough to block
Sammy. Can Sebastian Marley, another of my prey's minions, still
attempt to block?? Or does my prey only get one shot at blocking?

Say my predator's minion now tries to block. I presume that Sammy will
still have 2 stealth for the remainder of the action (i.e. he doesn't
reset after a failed block attempt).

LMK!

T'anks,
Madman
Apprentice Methusaleh

Messages.Author: Mikko Saari
Messages.Body:
Madman2001 <Mad...@madman.com> wrote:

> However, can one minion use two of the same cards during an action??

No, two same action modifiers are not allowed. Think about this: "I'll
bleed." "I don't block." "Ok, I'll just play these four Conditionings..."

> OK, let's say that Dre cannot get his intercept up enough to block
> Sammy. Can Sebastian Marley, another of my prey's minions, still
> attempt to block?? Or does my prey only get one shot at blocking?

Yes, he can try again with another vampire.

> Say my predator's minion now tries to block. I presume that Sammy will
> still have 2 stealth for the remainder of the action (i.e. he doesn't
> reset after a failed block attempt).

Yes, that stealth goes nowhere if someone doesn't especially remove it.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Mikko Saari wrote:
> Madman2001 <Mad...@madman.com> wrote:

> > However, can one minion use two of the same [action modifier] cards

> > during an action??
>
> No, two same action modifiers are not allowed. Think about this: "I'll
> bleed." "I don't block." "Ok, I'll just play these four Conditionings..."

Correct: the "same minion" cannot play the same action modifier twice on
a given action. (likewise for reaction cards).

Note that even without the rule limiting action modifiers, Conditioning
still could not be played in series due to explicit card text.

> > OK, let's say that Dre cannot get his intercept up enough to block
> > Sammy. Can Sebastian Marley, another of my prey's minions, still
> > attempt to block?? Or does my prey only get one shot at blocking?
>
> Yes, he can try again with another vampire.

Correct.

> > Say my predator's minion now tries to block. I presume that Sammy will
> > still have 2 stealth for the remainder of the action (i.e. he doesn't
> > reset after a failed block attempt).
>
> Yes, that stealth goes nowhere if someone doesn't especially remove it.

Correct, alterations to stealth and intercept apply for the duration of
the action, by default.
